gter chen stag sham nus ldan rdo rje'i zab gter bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam lha'i rnga chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru/mkha' khyab zhing bzhugs

tei:div.tei:p: )gter chen stag sham nus ldan rdo rje'i zab gter bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam lha'i rnga chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ mkha' khyab zhing bzhugs rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi// ye shes gcig bsdus dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag /lhar bcas srid dang zhi ba'i gtsug gi rgyan// o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rjes shis pa stsol// lnga brgya'i tha mar gdul dka'i sems can rnams// skyobs mdzad pad 'byung dngos snang bsam gtan gling*// rig 'dzin stag sham nus ldan rdo rje yi// zab gter bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas shog /bskyed dang rdzogs pa rdzogs pa chen po yi// rgyud lung man ngag rgya mtsho bsrub pa'i bcud// bla rdzogs thugs gsum nor bu'i lhun po yi// zab gter bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas shog /padma gsung gi sgrub sde'i yang snying mchog /rig 'dzin grub thob bye ba'i thugs khrag ni// yi dam dbang chen gsang sngags dgongs 'dus kyi// zab gter bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas shog /byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma zhi drag dang*// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam zhi dang khro// phrin las dpal ster mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi /zab gter bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas shog /rgyud kyi bshad bka' dbang gi chu bo dang*// gdams ngag nyams len sgrub phrin phyag bzhes bcas// snga 'gyur bka' bab chu bo bzhi ldan gyi// zab gter bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas shog /bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin dpag bsam rgyas pa'i rtser// mchog thun dngos grub 'bras bu'i khur gyis lci// sel med brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 'dod dgu 'jo// zab gter bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas shog /'di 'dzin 'chad spel dpe tsam bzhugs pa yi// yul phyogs gang der nad mug mtshon 'khrug zhi// lha min kla klo bdud sde mthar byed pa'i// zab gter bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas shog /ji srid 'khor ba stongs par ma gyur par// de srid dam pa'i chos 'di mi nub cing*// smin cing grol ba'i phrin las rlabs po che// zab gter bstan pa mi nub rgyas par shog

/gter 'byin rgya mtsho'i 'khor los bsgyur ba ni// dpal chen rdo rje gro lod stag sham rje'i// zab gter bstan pa 'dzam gling khyab pa dang*// phyogs dus kun khyab bkra shis bde legs shog /zhes pa'ang mtsho kha bla ma lung dang rtogs pa'i dbang phyug skal bzang 'gyur med nas bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas rin gnyis kyi me tog bcas gsung bskul ngor/ mkhyen brtse'i sprul ming 'dzin pa chos kyi blo gros pas gsol ba btab pa dge legs su gyur cig// /
